name: Yuxiang
source:
A half-demon. His father is a human, and his mother is a monster made of a blue bird. Yuxiang is his twin brother.

Compared with his younger sister, he has a more calm personality and admires the chief of the clan. He studies all kind of difficult subjects. Although he cares greatly for his sister, he struggles at expressing it.

He feels that being a half-demon shouldn't matter, and he just wants to live a peaceful life now.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630/_/]Steam[/url]]
